description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'extractOrganization' that extracts an organization identifier from HTTP request headers, query parameters, or body, and attaches it to the request object for downstream use. It also provides helper functions for filtering and stamping documents with organization info, and includes debug logging.

methods.name: extractOrganization
methods.description: Returns an Express middleware function that extracts organization ID from request headers, query, or body, attaches it to the request object, and enforces scoping rules.
